task.name: pick_vial_place_middle_slot
task.description: Use the left arm to pick up the vial and place it in the middle empty slot on the rack.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the vial.
2. Grasp the vial with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to align with the middle empty slot on the rack.
4. Release the gripper to place the vial into the middle empty slot on the rack.
